Independently enumerated all distinct factors and their complete interval-union masks from freshly generated words: 7008,28128,112608,450528 factors, and precisely 48,64,80,96 inclusion-minimal coverage masks. An independently coded JS BigInt certificate check verified all listed 10/11/12/12-point witnesses hit EVERY mask and integer incidence-duals achieve lower bounds 9/10/11/12, with multiplicities 1/1/2/2. Independently coded exhaustive exact-cover recursion, restricting equality-to-dual and satisfying additional core coverages, found NO smaller 9/10/11 solutions (27,2194,1278 memo states under different pruning), while at 1024 dual=upper=12. The recursion branches on each uncovered positive-dual coverage with exact feasibility pruning and keeps undominated incidence options, proving those three finite exclusions, not relying on a solver log.
